01. Data Acquisition & Status

Source: vignettes/data-acquisition.Rmd
data-acquisition.Rmd

Overview

This report summarizes the initial data acquisition step for the MMRF CoMMpass study. We access Open Access RNA-seq data from the GDC S3 bucket (s3://gdc-mmrf-commpass-phs000748-2-open/) via the targets pipeline.

Pipeline Configuration

Pipeline Configuration
Parameter Value
Project ID MMRF-COMMPASS
Sample Limit 10
Data Directory data
Results Directory results
Random Seed 42

RNA-seq Data

RNA-seq gene expression data is downloaded from GDC as a SummarizedExperiment object.
